answer: Re-attestations are stored in terrace and walnut lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ferrous graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1951 impostors cost 743 times the honest price and take 4 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
